content.comment_body: Hello. Does anyone know if it is possible to send emails from [product_name] without needing a SIM card or mobile network settings? Specifically, can emails be sent using only a LAN internet connection, similar to what some versions of [product_name] appear to support? Thanks. [user_name]
Based on what I know, this is not possible.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members are unsure whether [product_name] can send emails using only a LAN internet connection, without a SIM card or mobile network, as seen in certain newer [company_name] devices. Lack of clear information or documentation leads to confusion and further questions, highlighting communication gaps regarding connectivity options.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope [product_name] will allow email sending over a LAN connection, similar to newer devices from [company_name], without needing a SIM card or mobile network.
